slides.title: THE LAW
slides.note: Voltage (V) equals current (I) times resistance (R). Power (P) equals current times voltage.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 1
slides.problem: A 12 V battery drives a 4 Ω resistor. Find the current.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 2
slides.problem: How much power does that resistor use?

slides.title: WATCH OUT
points: Current is voltage divided by resistance: I = V / R.
Check units: volts, amps, ohms, watts.

pageTitle: Ohm's Law: Voltage, Current, and Resistance
description: Learn V = IR and the power formula with two worked examples and the most common mix-up.
